pulse: Sunday premarket setup stays risk-off into the 6 PM ET NQ/ES reopen: Friday's AI/semis rout (Nasdaq -5.3%, NVDA -14% to $125.53) plus Iran's overnight Bahrain strikes (Gulf states now condemning a hit on a civilian industrial site) keep gap-down and CL-spike risk high; the offsets are the 10y easing to ~4.91% from 5.15% w/w and Iran's president signaling he wants out of 'neither war nor peace'.
bias: risk-off — semis liquidation (worst week since 2001 per X chatter) and NVDA leadership/SEC overhang plus Iran-Bahrain escalation dominate into the reopen; lower yields and washed-out sentiment are the bounce risk
items: @moving_markets (~2:52 AM ET): Friday close recap — S&P -3.7% to 6,910, Nasdaq -5.3%, NVDA -14% to $125.53; 10y eased to 4.91% from 5.15% a week ago — Bearish NQ
@FirstSquawk (~7:18 AM ET): Qatar condemns the Iranian attack on a civilian industrial facility in Bahrain (Saudi, Jordan also condemn) — Bearish NQ (Gulf escalation, CL up)
@FirstSquawk (~6:19 AM ET): Iranian president says Iran must exit the 'neither war nor peace' state ASAP; Qalibaf accuses US of economic pressure to collapse Iran — Mixed NQ
@zerohedge (~7:30 AM ET): Bessent says Trump and Xi agreed AI should not be autonomous for major military actions — Mixed NQ (US-China AI détente read)
@unusual_whales (~12:01 AM ET): AMD fell sharply after Hunterbrook reported possible China export-control violations and disclosed a short — Bearish NQ (semis)
trump: No new market-moving Trump posts overnight. Bessent (via @zerohedge, ~7:30 AM ET) says Trump and Xi agreed AI 'should not be allowed to be autonomous for major military actions'; Trump still backing a 10% credit-card rate cap (Saturday in America interview).
watch: Sun 6:00 PM ET NQ/ES reopen (gap risk on Bahrain/Hormuz headlines, CL/Brent); NVDA board/SEC probe headlines; AMD export-control fallout; Mon Nov 23 AMC HPE, ZM; Tue Nov 24 BMO ADI, AMC DELL/WDAY/ADSK/HPQ/NTNX; Thu Nov 26 Thanksgiving (cash closed), Fri Nov 27 half day; Dec FOMC hike pricing.
